title: Smaller notes
summary: Split a beat in two and you get eighth notes.

steps.title: Eighth note
steps.body:
Split a beat into two equal halves and each half is an **eighth note**. Count them "1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and". Eighth notes are drawn with a flag, or joined in pairs by a beam.

**Why it matters:** Eighth notes drive most rock and pop: the steady "chug" of a guitar or the hi-hat of a drum kit.

steps.title: Counting eighths
steps.body: Say "1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and", tapping on every word.

items.prompt: Tap eight eighth notes, counting "1 and 2 and": 8 taps.
Tap two quarter notes, then four eighth notes: 6 taps.

steps.title: Eighth-note chords
steps.body: Play a C chord in eighth notes for a bar, then F, then G. That is the classic rock rhythm.

items.prompt: How many eighth notes last as long as one quarter note?
Tap four eighth notes, then two quarter notes: 6 taps.
